'''Vagol Oss''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] who settled on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] during the era of the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="ACI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vagol Oss first appeared in the [[March]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.4.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
